Improving the lives of dogs with
cancer
Cancer is one of the
leading cause of death
in dogs and cats
Approximately 1 in 4 dogs and 1 in 5 cats will get cancer in their lifetimes
​
Yet, the majority
do not receive treatment
Up to 66% of pets owners decline treatment due to concerns about
cost, quality of life and side effects
of treatment. ​
And the majority of pets with cancer
never visit a specialist
due to costs, access to specialist clinics and time commitment.
Kv9 is a
series of injections into a tumour
that teach a dog’s immune system to
fight its own cancer
​
​
​
​
​
​
Its designed to be
administered by any veterinarian,
more affordable,
and, low risk to quality of life
​
​
Kv9 is currently undergoing clinical studies
